roadster.reason: Sectional wedge, mechanical rear/undertray and independent wheels; A too blocky, B canopy frame too heavy.

ramp.reason: Continuous paneled curve and curved truss; refined overhang, ground contact and rear supports after scene review.

floodlight.reason: Readable recessed lamps and tripod from all four sides; C had weaker side readability.

boundary.reason: Low segmented red LED boundary with bolted feet matches source.

pavement.reason: Continuous slab avoids visible tile gaps; shallow geometry is intentionally evaluated from above in scene.

servicevan.reason: Faceted cab, windscreen, lights, mirrors and rear doors are readable at aerial scale.
